description: oracle/value_coverage.py's configuration (FID-10): the maps whose keys are ids, and each compared field of the goldens that takes one value in the scenario set, with why.

classes.allocator.reason: One allocator in the scenario set; a paged scenario (page size above 1) moves it (inference-sim/blis-sglang#32).

classes.tree_cache.reason: One tree cache in the scenario set; disable_radix_cache and further tree caches move it (inference-sim/blis-sglang#32).

classes.tree_core.reason: SGL-1: the oracle selects the Python tree core, and run_scheduler.py fails on any other.

finished.*.reason.type.reason: Every request ends on its length; a request ending on EOS or a stop token moves it (inference-sim/blis-sglang#32).

harness_problems.reason: A run with a harness problem writes no trace, so a golden always records none.

receive.max_recv_per_poll.reason: The oracle counts a step per loop iteration and needs the default receive settings; the runner fails otherwise.

receive.scheduler_recv_interval.reason: The oracle counts a step per loop iteration and needs the default receive settings; the runner fails otherwise.

resolved.attention_backend.reason: The oracle's base platform runs torch_native attention (oracle/mocks.json, "the base platform").

resolved.device.reason: The oracle's base platform is the CPU device (oracle/mocks.json, "the base platform").

sglang_env.SGLANG_UNIFIED_RADIX_TREE_COR.reason: SGL-1: the one SGLANG_* variable the runner sets (KEPT_SGLANG_ENV), selecting the Python tree core.

shutdown_sent.reason: A run whose loop returned before the harness's ShutdownReq writes no trace.

steps.reason: A run with no step writes no trace (no forward pass ran).

steps[].forwards[].extend_prefix_lens.reason: A forward pass has at least one request, so its per-request list is never empty.

steps[].forwards[].extend_seq_lens.reason: A forward pass has at least one request, so its per-request list is never empty.

steps[].forwards[].loop.file.reason: Every forward pass must come from SGLang's managers/scheduler.py; the runner fails otherwise.

steps[].forwards[].loop.upstream_code.reason: Every forward pass must come from SGLang's own loop at the checkout; the runner fails otherwise.

steps[].forwards[].seq_lens.reason: A forward pass has at least one request, so its per-request list is never empty.

steps[].outputs[].finished.reason: Every output finishes a request; a streamed request's earlier outputs move it (inference-sim/blis-sglang#32).

steps[].outputs[].output_lens.reason: An output names at least one request, with its length.

steps[].outputs[].rids.reason: An output names at least one request.

steps[].outputs[].type.reason: The oracle skips tokenizer init (oracle/mocks.json), so every output is a BatchTokenIDOutput.

steps[].shutdown.reason: Recorded only on the step that sent the ShutdownReq, as true.

truncated.reason: A run that did not finish within max_steps writes no trace.
